name: Tara Topic
bio: Hi, I’m Tara and I’m passionate about turning your real estate dreams into reality! With a deep understanding of the local market and a keen eye for detail, I’m dedicated to providing exceptional service and making your buying or selling experience smooth and successful. Whether you’re looking for your perfect home or aiming to sell, I’m here to guide you every step of the way with confidence and enthusiasm. Let’s make your real estate journey an exciting adventure together!

name: Adithya Micheal
bio: I specialise in helping buyers and investors find the right opportunities across Dubai’s key communities. From understanding current market values to spotting the properties worth a closer look, my focus is on giving clients the full picture so they can make decisions with confidence. Every client’s goal is different, and my job is to match the property to the person.

name: Anne Aristan
bio: Ann is a driven and resourceful Office Administrator and Executive Assistant with extensive experience in the real estate industry. She specializes in executive support, office administration, real estate coordination, client relations, and day-to-day business operations.

Highly organized and detail-oriented, Ann excels in managing high-volume workloads, coordinating with agents and clients, and ensuring smooth and efficient office operations. She brings strong communication, customer service, HR, and problem-solving skills, with a professional and hands-on approach to every task.

name: Jasko Miletic
bio: Jasko Miletic is the founder of Dubai Rapid Properties and has been active in Dubai’s real estate market since 2007.

With nearly two decades of hands-on experience, Mr. Jasko has built his reputation on market knowledge, direct relationships, transparency and a highly personal approach to every transaction. Over the years, he has worked with private investors, property owners and international clients across Dubai, with particular expertise in luxury residential properties, investment opportunities, sales, leasing and property management.

Under his leadership, Dubai Rapid Properties has evolved beyond traditional brokerage into a fully integrated real estate platform, offering clients a complete range of services – from property acquisition and sales to holiday home management, furnishing, maintenance and ongoing property management.

Jasko believes that real estate is ultimately a relationship business. His philosophy remains simple: understand the client’s goals, provide straightforward advice and stay personally involved until the desired result is achieved.

name: Dulshan Imantha
bio: At D|R|P, my job is to make sure the right people see the right properties at the right time. With a background in design and technology, I bring creative ideas and data together to build campaigns that actually bring results. For me, great marketing isn’t about noise. It’s about telling each property’s story in a way that connects with buyers and investors.

name: Neel Mehra
bio: As a trusted advisor at D|R|P, I focus on matching clients with investments that align with both their lifestyle and financial goals. I believe in going the extra mile — whether it’s finding rare deals, providing detailed insights, or negotiating the best terms. For me, success is when my clients succeed.
